svg.title: Best-of-N and pass^k
svg.desc: Several builder models each build a candidate. Each candidate runs a shared test suite three times. A test passes only when all runs pass. The leader wins, or a judge decides between close candidates.
svg.text: Best-of-N and pass^k: keep the agent that passes every time
The same request can give a 0.98 agent in one build and a 0.49 agent in the next. Anvil builds several candidates and measures each one more than once.

g.text: no answer in the time limit.
Its build stops. No more cost.
Shared test suite, each test runs k = 3 times
given tests first (weight 2), then the tests of the candidates
pass^k: a test passes only when all k runs pass.
One lucky run does not count. A test with 2 of 3
good runs is a failed test. passAny shows the share
with at least one good run.
